description: [Procurement] Find open EU public tenders a company could bid on. Use when building a bid pipeline or sales leads from public procurement. Price: $0.03 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/eu-tenders

countries.description: Comma-separated buyer countries, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. DE,FR,PL)

cpv.description: Comma-separated CPV codes (8 digits, prefix match on divisions e.g. 72000000)

min_days_to_deadline.description: Only tenders whose submission deadline is at least N days away (default 0 = still open)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

query.description: Keywords (full-text, all words must match), e.g. 'cybersecurity' or 'office furniture'

name: search_tenders
title: EU Public Tender Search (TED) ($0.03)
